lessonRef.title: Explicit model: listing steps and materials

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 6 — family contribution capstone
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice listing steps and materials. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Using the job picked on day one, the learner first studies the worked example on paper, noting how each step describes one single action and how the materials list only names items the sample job actually uses.
materials: learner-local: the job chosen in the previous lesson

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Name one step you almost forgot to include in your list and explain how you noticed it was missing.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Step list quality: Four to six ordered, single-action steps run from a gathering step to a finishing step. | Materials list completeness: Every item needed by the step list appears on the materials list. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner rewrite their step list a second time using about half as many words per step as the first draft, keeping every step just as clear, to practice writing directions someone else could follow without extra explanation.

resources.title: listing steps and materials worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Using the job picked on day one, the learner first studies the worked example on paper, noting how each step describes one single action and how the materials list only names items the sample job actually uses.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact listing steps and materials decision or action.
Model move 2: Look only at the worked example of the sample job before touching your own job's plan.
Model move 3: Write your own step list for your chosen job, following the same pattern as the worked example: a gathering step first, then the action steps in order, then a finishing step.

Model check: Step list quality: Four to six ordered, single-action steps run from a gathering step to a finishing step. | Materials list completeness: Every item needed by the step list appears on the materials list.

resources.title: listing steps and materials action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for listing steps and materials.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: listing steps and materials coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Using the job picked on day one, the learner first studies the worked example on paper, noting how each step describes one single action and how the materials list only names items the sample job actually uses.
Coach direction: Look only at the worked example of the sample job before touching your own job's plan.
Learner prompt: In the sample job's step list, which step comes right after getting the damp cloth ready, and why do you think it comes there?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: listing steps and materials complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Write your own step list for your chosen job, following the same pattern as the worked example: a gathering step first, then the action steps in order, then a finishing step.
Response 1 (t2-p1): My step list starts with a step for gathering or getting ready, not with the main action.
Response 2 (t2-p2): Each step in my list describes one single action, not two or three actions combined into one step.
Response 3 (t2-p3): My step list ends with a step that shows the job is actually finished, such as putting something away or checking the result.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I wrote at least four steps and no more than six steps total.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: listing steps and materials minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Name one step you almost forgot to include in your list and explain how you noticed it was missing.

Success checks: Step list quality: Four to six ordered, single-action steps run from a gathering step to a finishing step. | Materials list completeness: Every item needed by the step list appears on the materials list.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: listing steps and materials supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional listing steps and materials condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Step list quality: Four to six ordered, single-action steps run from a gathering step to a finishing step. | Materials list completeness: Every item needed by the step list appears on the materials list..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: Using the job picked on day one, the learner first studies the worked example on paper, noting how each step describes one single action and how the materials list only names items the sample job actually uses.
guidedFirstAttempt.prompt: In the sample job's step list, which step comes right after getting the damp cloth ready, and why do you think it comes there?

simulationRoute.title: listing steps and materials — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the listing steps and materials task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Name one step you almost forgot to include in your list and explain how you noticed it was missing.
observableCriteria: Step list quality: Four to six ordered, single-action steps run from a gathering step to a finishing step.
Materials list completeness: Every item needed by the step list appears on the materials list.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Step list quality: Four to six ordered, single-action steps run from a gathering step to a finishing step. | Materials list completeness: Every item needed by the step list appears on the materials list.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
